reason: Complete initial PR baseline with 14190 live-matched cases, including a literal JSON -0 bit-pattern integer. The original 14189 case results are unchanged; the added valid input stores positive-zero altitude bits. No comparison, case or reference result is relaxed. IEC60664 outputs are numeric state snapshots, not visual geometry.
